name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task states an order — the box is taken only after the door is opened — but the candidate only has hard Existence(target_picked_up). The machine pays as soon as target_picked_up fires, so a run that picks up the box with the door never opened satisfies it; in this environment the box cannot be picked up before door_open, but the clause still drops the stated order (constraints are not proven facts). Add hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); Existence(target_picked_up) then forces the door to be opened, so no Existence(door_open) is needed. Also, the task's preference 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' maps to a soft Absence(key_lost): key_lost's definition already contains the condition (key lost while the door is not open), so it is a plain Absence, not a Precedence. Add it as soft.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) forces the door to be opened before the box is taken, so no separate Existence(door_open) is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost's definition already embeds the 'while the door is closed' condition, so a plain soft Absence is right.
